p: return unto the LORD thy God: He exhorts them to repentance to avoid all these plagues, exhorting them to declare by words their obedience and repentance.
Take away all iniquity: He shows them that they ought to confess their sins.
lips: Declaring that this is the true sacrifice that the faithful can offer, even thanks and praise; He 13:15.
not save us: We will forsake all vain confidence and pride.
I will heal their backsliding: He declares how ready God is to receive those that do repent.
shadow shall return: Whoever unites themselves to this people will be blessed.
have heard him: God shows how prompt he is to hear his own when they repent, and to offer himself as a protection and safeguard for them, as a most sufficient fruit and benefit.
wise: Signifying that the true wisdom and knowledge consists in this, even to rest upon God.
